name: Faith Seven
about: Faith Seven (1963-015A), a crewed vehicle (Mercury MA), launched 1963 May 15. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1963 May 15), held fixed
